title: T1055.002 — Process Injection - Portable Executable Injection
subtitle: Interactive walkthrough of Process Injection - Portable Executable Injection with the technique-specific attack path and defender evidence.
aria: Animated diagram of portable executable injection: a packed dropper copies a full PE image into the memory of explorer.exe, a remote thread starts it, and the SOC analyst captures memory to confirm the implant.

steps.title: Foothold
steps.caption: A user opens a fake installer from a phishing email. The packed dropper starts, shows a normal setup screen, and quietly prepares its hidden payload.
steps.defender: Sysmon EID 1 logs a new process in a user-writable folder with an unusual parent chain; a fresh or missing signature is another hint.

fields.detail: A user opens a fake installer from a phishing email. The packed dropper starts, shows a normal setup

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Read payload
steps.caption: The dropper decrypts its own resources and unpacks a complete hidden PE image into a private memory buffer.
steps.defender: EDR (endpoint detection and response) sees unusual section activity - large executable-looking regions appear inside the dropper before it touches other processes.

fields.detail: The dropper decrypts its own resources and unpacks a complete hidden PE image into a private memory

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Open + allocate
steps.caption: The dropper opens the trusted explorer.exe with OpenProcess and reserves fresh read-write (RW) memory inside it with VirtualAllocEx.
steps.defender: Sysmon EID 10 records cross-process access with sensitive rights, and an EDR rule flags the new writable region in a trusted process.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Write full PE image
steps.caption: WriteProcessMemory copies the PE headers and all sections into the new region, relocation fixups adjust the image for its new base address, and VirtualProtectEx raises the memory protection to executable.
steps.defender: the region now holds image-like bytes that start with an MZ header and run executable, but no file backs them - an unbacked image region.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Start execution
steps.caption: CreateRemoteThread starts a new thread in the target at the PE entry offset. No LoadLibrary call happens at any point.
steps.defender: Sysmon EID 8 shows a remote thread whose StartModule and StartFunction are empty, because the start address belongs to no module.

fields.detail: CreateRemoteThread starts a new thread in the target at the PE entry offset. No LoadLibrary call hap

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Implant runs
steps.caption: The implant finishes initializing inside explorer.exe. It is now a complete, memory-only program living inside a trusted process.
steps.defender: EDR memory scanning finds unsigned executable code running inside a signed, trusted process.

fields.detail: The implant finishes initializing inside explorer.exe. It is now a complete, memory-only program liv

detection.label: Partial signal
detection.detail: A weak signal exists but is not yet a confirmed alert.

steps.title: Hidden activity
steps.caption: From inside the trusted process, the implant polls the C2 server over HTTPS and waits for tasks.
steps.defender: network monitoring sees a periodic beacon flow from a process that never spoke like this before; egress baselines make it stand out.

fields.detail: From inside the trusted process, the implant polls the C2 server over HTTPS and waits for tasks. net

detection.label: Alert raised
detection.detail: The SOC has enough evidence to open an incident.

steps.title: SOC triage
steps.caption: The SOC analyst captures triage memory. Scanners reveal the in-memory PE, and the host is isolated from the network.
steps.defender: the alert chain lines up - new process, cross-process write, unbacked thread, beacon flow - and memory forensics confirms a full PE image.
